sources.title: GitHub - fpgaminer/joytag: The JoyTag Image Tagging Model
sources.snippet: JoyTag is a state of the art AI vision model for tagging images, with a focus on sex positivity and inclusivity. It uses the Danbooru tagging schema, but works across a wide range of images, from hand drawn to photographic.
